args.explanation: Mean inflow 8 (up to ~9.6 with noise) exceeds max outflow demand 1 + valve 6 =7, so level climbs until it would exceed capacity. Declared behavior says excess should spill and level be capped at capacity, but at step 15 level is 40.5857 > capacity 40 while spilled remains 0. Likely cause is missing/incorrect spill capping when inflow overwhelms drains.
